import json, hashlib, sys
from pathlib import Path

target=Path("/Users/steventran/do-again")
req_id="selfdev-issue10-final-closure-audit-20261008-132"
key=hashlib.sha256(str(target.resolve()).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
root=Path.home()/".do_again/projects"/key
state=root/"state"

sys.path.insert(0,"/Users/steventran/do-again/src")
from do_again.service.daemon import _drain_browser_outbox

outbox=state/"browser_outbox"
uncertain=state/"browser_delivery_uncertain.json"
target_file=outbox/f"{req_id}.json"

if not target_file.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("precondition failed: expected queued self receipt missing")
if uncertain.exists():
    raise SystemExit("precondition failed: uncertain delivery already exists")

delivered=_drain_browser_outbox(target,state)

items=sorted(p.name for p in outbox.glob("*.json")) if outbox.is_dir() else []
browser_status={}
try:
    browser_status=json.loads((state/"browser_status.json").read_text())
except Exception:
    pass

print(json.dumps({
  "delivered":delivered,
  "remaining_outbox":items,
  "uncertain_exists":uncertain.exists(),
  "browser_status":browser_status,
},indent=2,sort_keys=True))

if delivered != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f"expected exactly one delivered receipt, got {delivered}")
if req_id+".json" in items:
    raise SystemExit("delivered self receipt still present in outbox")
if uncertain.exists():
    raise SystemExit("delivery left uncertain marker behind")
if browser_status.get("state")!="ready":
    raise SystemExit(f"browser delivery not ready after verified send: {browser_status}")

print("SELF_QUEUED_RECEIPT_DELIVERY_ACCEPTANCE_OK")
